s: Din minyan hashshitin ubo b' seipim: nahagu beminyan hashshitin al pi haqqabbala beyad hassoperim ish mippi ish, liktob beshel yad sheba shitin bekol parasha uparasha, ubeshel rosh arba shitin bekol parasha uparasha. Veim shinna — lo pasal. Veyesh lahem gam ken qabbala betebot rashe shitin beshel yad ubeshel rosh. Vehassoperim shellanu medaqdeqim beminyan hashshitin, abal berashe hashshitin enan nizharin, umeshannim kaasher yizdammen lahem. Umi sheyyirtzeh ledaqdeq bahem, im yukal lekavven hashshitin beinyan zeh — yaaseh, abal lo yaarik viqatztzer haotiyyot kede lekavven rashe hashshitot:

Abal yakol lehaarik meat haotiyyot beshita sheniyya kede lekavven sope hashshitot, velo aseru ella lehamshikan kol-kak beinyan sheyyehe nireh laayin shehen gedolot mechabrotehem venireh hakketab kimnummar, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman rag verah:
